new.readme: tiny-voca is a small English text-to-speech model. It has two voices, 4.5M parameters, and runs on a CPU or in the browser. new.readme: Mute your Mac. Your trackpad will still talk. There's no speaker in a MacBook trackpad, just a small haptic motor that taps the glass so you feel a click. new.description: XNU as a loadable kernel module inside Linux (macOS personality for arm64 Linux)
new.readme: Run macOS userspace on Linux by loading the macOS kernel into it. xnulinux builds XNU, the open-source kernel of macOS, from Apple's published sources and runs it as a loadable kernel module (xnu.ko) inside an unmodified arm64 Linux kernel. The hosted XNU drives the CPU and MMU directly, so macOS processes run natively next to Linux processes on the same CPUs, with no hypervisor between them. Linux lends XNU its memory, timers, files, network and GPU through a small interface module (fki.ko).

items.title: Red teams can cut false positives by gating BugHunter findings through deterministic rules
items.connection: open-code-review's hybrid of deterministic rules and an LLM agent is a template for filtering the agent-driven findings from Claude-BugHunter, whose accuracy its popularity does not prove.
items.context: security teams lose most triage time on false positives
chain: Claude-BugHunter adds 2,037 stars in a day, so many red teams are now producing agent-found vulnerability reports.
Nothing in its source shows those findings are accurate.
Applying open-code-review's rules-first pattern means an LLM finding must also match a deterministic check before a human sees it.
Pentest firms can offer cheaper retests on authorized engagements, and internal appsec desks can absorb more agent output without more analysts.
items.who: Pentest consultancies and internal appsec teams benefit; clients paying for engagements and retests fund it.
items.versus: Raw agent findings flood triage and erode trust, while doing nothing leaves teams unable to use a tool their peers are adopting.
items.smallest_test: Run BugHunter against an intentionally vulnerable practice app with a known bug list, then filter through rules modeled on open-code-review; success if the filter removes at least half the false positives while keeping at least 90% of true ones.
items.disconfirm: The rules drop true findings at about the same rate as false ones.

items.body: Teams building interactive video world models can read hidden states from a frozen diffusion transformer to detect and reduce these physical violations.
